skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts about investment projects and the process of creating and managing them.
Analyze various aspects of an investment project including macroeconomic environment, market research, technical analysis, and organizational management.
Conduct financial analysis of investment projects using tools like Net Present Value (NPV), Internal Rate of Return (IRR), and other financial metrics.
Evaluate the economic and social impacts of investment projects, including environmental impact assessments.
Apply project management techniques such as scheduling, cost control, and risk management.
Work effectively in teams to complete project tasks.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and solve problems related to investment projects.
Enhance self-learning abilities to independently study and apply new concepts in investment project management.
Understand legal requirements and adhere to institutional rules and regulations.
Prepare and deliver effective presentations on investment project analysis and management.
